why_chosen: The entry-level case, and a hallucination trap: it names no technology at all, so any language or tool the analyzer reports is invented.
judgment_calls: '0-2 years' -> min_years_experience 0 (the stated lower bound), not null.
Seniority: the title says 'Junior', so seniority is 'junior' and seniority_source is 'stated'.
'CS fundamentals' is listed beside its two elaborations (data structures, algorithms) because an ATS keyword search could hit any of them.
'at least one language you're comfortable building projects in' names no language, so it yields no skill.
'new-grad friendly' states no degree, so education stays empty.
Eagerness to learn and communication are soft skills: excluded from skills.

responsibilities: rotate across two teams in the first year
